description: This source file defines a custom exception class 'AcknowledgementRequestTimeoutException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It signals that an acknowledgement request did not receive a response within a specified timeout period. The class provides constructors, a builder, and JSON serialization/deserialization methods specific to this exception type.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequestTimeoutException
classes.description: A final immutable class representing a timeout exception for acknowledgement requests when no response is received within a specified duration. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements AcknowledgementException, providing constructors, JSON deserialization, and a builder for creating instances.

methods.description: Returns a builder instance for further customization.
